```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH

# Create a new document
doc = Document()

# Add title
title = doc.add_heading('Q1 2024 Project Status Report', 0)
title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

# Add some spacing
doc.add_paragraph()

# Executive Summary section
doc.add_heading('Executive Summary', level=1)
exec_summary = """This report provides an overview of the Q1 2024 project initiatives. The project has made significant progress in the first quarter, delivering key features and establishing a solid foundation for subsequent phases. Overall project health is rated as GOOD, with minor delays in non-critical path items that have been mitigated through resource reallocation."""
doc.add_paragraph(exec_summary)

# Key Milestones section
doc.add_heading('Key Milestones', level=1)
milestones = """1. Requirement Analysis - COMPLETED (March 15, 2024)\n2. System Architecture Design - COMPLETED (March 30, 2024)\n3. Core Module Development - IN PROGRESS (85% complete)\n4. User Acceptance Testing - SCHEDULED (April 15, 2024)\n5. Production Deployment - SCHEDULED (May 1, 2024)"""
doc.add_paragraph(milestones)

# Next Steps section
doc.add_heading('Next Steps', level=1)
next_steps = """The following priorities have been identified for Q2 2024:\n1. Complete core module development by April 10\n2. Initiate user acceptance testing protocols\n3. Conduct security audit and penetration testing\n4. Prepare deployment documentation and rollback procedures\n5. Schedule training sessions for end-users"""
doc.add_paragraph(next_steps)

# Add table for project phases
doc.add_heading('Project Phase Completion Overview', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph()

# Create table
table = doc.add_table(rows=5, cols=2)
table.style = 'Table Grid'

# Table headers
table.rows[0].cells[0].text = 'Phase'
table.rows[0].cells[1].text = 'Completion %'

# Table data
phases = [
    ('Requirements Gathering', 100),
    ('Design Phase', 100),
    ('Development', 85),
    ('Testing', 0),
    ('Deployment', 0)
]

for row_idx, (phase, completion) in enumerate(phases, start=1):
    table.rows[row_idx].cells[0].text = phase
    table.rows[row_idx].cells[1].text = str(completion)

# Save the document
doc.save('/workspace/project_report.docx')
print("Document created successfully!")
```
